scientific_limitations_and_integrity: The theorem assumes finitely many positive-definite quadratic minima, continuous positive invariant densities at the minima, uniform exponential mixing on a compact periodic space, and symmetric jump kernels. It proves a nondegenerate stable functional limit and sharpness only within this class. The classical Laplace saddlepoint correction is credited to prior analogous time-periodic work. One relevant 2006 original full text was not accessible; historical priority is qualified. No independent audit has been performed.
title: Logarithmically corrected stable limits at isolated minima of periodic jump indices
